label: First Way mover is a necessary actual first root, from the grounding closure (inference)
rule: Root by firstness and irreflexivity; necessity by reductio on the grounding closure
meaning: Route A in the selected-grounding vocabulary of the root route. The first mover f is concrete and exists at w (B0, B0'). Any actual concrete ground of f is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to it (grounding-priority), so by firstness it is f, which would ground itself against irreflexivity: f is an actual root. Were f absent at some accessible world, it would be an actual contingent concretum, so the existing closure premise (every actual contingent concretum has an actual concrete ground) would give it such a ground. So f is present at every accessible world. No well-foundedness, inhabitedness or whole-roster premise is used: firstness of the First Way's mover replaces the minimal-element step of the existing necessary-root derivation.
